trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the instant your 54th trophy does. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the stranger strands before their cutoffs, then the grind trophies (stunts, shooting range, card sets, WAiNK, vehicles, bank vaults, 100%) — and this falls out on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Pops at the close of the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the very first story beat after character creation. Just follow the on-screen objectives; there is nothing to miss this early.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for clearing every main-story mission inside Chapter 1. Push through the chapter's missions in sequence; side content isn't required for this one.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 2's story missions are finished. Keep rolling through the main quest line — this chapter introduces the drug-running set pieces the title riffs on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Earned on finishing Chapter 3, which is where the story properly relocates the action into Vice City itself. Continue the main missions to trigger it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Pops once Chapter 4's missions are wrapped. By this point most of the strangers' early strands are already available — good time to check their progress before pushing further.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Awarded for rolling credits on the main story. Finish every stranger strand, collectible run and side trophy you want beforehand if you'd rather not chase them in post-game free roam, since some content gates change after the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Tied to the main-story mission Breakfast Run, an early trust-building job. Simply complete it as part of the story progression.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Pops after The Cartel Heist story mission concludes successfully. Plan the heist approach the mission gives you and see it through to the getaway.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Earned for finishing the story mission Child's Play. Stay on the main quest line and this arrives naturally mid-story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unlocked by completing the Headliners mission, a mid-game story set piece. No special conditions — just clear it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Pops when VCIA Takedown is finished, one of the more vehicle-heavy story missions. Keep your ride intact through the chase sections to avoid a restart.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Earned for completing Operation Savage Glory, a late-story mission. Push through its combat encounters — it sits close to the finale on the roadmap.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The completion percentage counts every story mission, stranger strand, activity type, collectible set and side objective the game tracks. Save this for dead last — clearing every other trophy on this list will put the percentage at or very near 100% already.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, barrel rolls, near-misses and similar tricks tracked passively while driving, biking or flying. Spend time riding ramps, overpasses and the coastal highway — big air and drift chains rack these up fast, no dedicated stunt mode needed.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida's activity map has nine distinct activity types (races, shooting range, arcade games, fishing, drone racing, and more). Start one instance of each from the map — you only need to begin and finish once per type, not master any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges need a gold time/accuracy rating. Upgrade weapon handling perks first, and replay individual stages rather than full sets — golds are about hitboxes and reload timing more than raw aim.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations scattered across Leonida. Win (not just finish) a single race at each — memorize gate shortcuts on repeat attempts if the AI drones are keeping pace.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 separate race events — street races, off-road, boat and air races all appear to count toward the total. Favor shorter circuits with fewer opponents to clear the count efficiently.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing-minigame rival introduced through the early fishing activity. Challenge him directly and land a bigger catch or higher score than his in a single round.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find any working arcade cabinet in a bar or storefront and play one mini-game to its end screen. Any arcade title on offer satisfies this — no high score required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's stranger strand needs to be picked up and fully resolved before the story moves past the point where his missions stop appearing. Check his map icon regularly through the mid-game chapters and finish his arc before the finale locks it out.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand is a stranger chain that can be permanently closed off once the main story advances far enough. Track him down early and clear every mission in his chain in one sitting if possible.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's final stranger mission needs his whole chain finished first. Like the other strand trophies, don't let the main story outrun him — resolve his questline before the late chapters.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Needs 8 full stranger strands finished, not just started — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone's chains count toward this total along with the others scattered across the map. Keep a running list of which strangers you've located so none slip past their cutoff.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand wraps up a running supply-chain subplot. Seek him out once he appears on the map and close out every step before it stops being offered.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's chain is one of the quirkier stranger strands. Finish all of his missions back to back once unlocked to avoid losing track of where he left off.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across the state. Use the pause-menu map's activity filter to mark each one and ride a circuit visiting them in sequence, sitting through the short meditation animation at each.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret hands out a hunting job for a specific, uniquely marked animal. Accept it from him directly and track the animal with a suitable weapon — finish his strand before story progression removes the contact.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are grouped into sets found at fixed world locations. Use an online or in-game collectible map to route between card spawns efficiently and complete 3 whole sets — partial sets don't count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-world app/sticker-tagging activity; it needs 100 separate locations marked. Treat it like a long-haul collectible crawl — do it alongside other map-based trophies (vehicles, meditation spots) on the same driving loops.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's short side-objective pop-ups (timed stunts, delivery runs, mini-games). Opt into them whenever the prompt appears during free roam; 50 completions accumulate naturally if you say yes often.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build up to a 4-star wanted level while your partner is riding with you, then successfully lose the cops together. Ducking into a respray shop or breaking line of sight in a tunnel with both of you in the vehicle works well.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hit 3 robbable storefronts in a row with your partner present, keeping whatever wanted level you pick up from the first robbery alive through all three. Plan a short driving route between nearby shops so the stars don't fade between hits.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discovery tracks distinct vehicle models you've driven or ridden in, not duplicates. Visit dealerships, impound lots and varied neighborhoods to rack up unique models toward the 100 total.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mechanic. Trigger it only once at least 5 enemies are grouped and visible, then chain headshots or quick kills before the meter runs dry.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Tied to the airport-set story beats around VCIA. During the relevant mission, improvise an escape rather than the scripted path — commandeer transport and break out before security locks the area down.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhino tanks show up at high wanted levels or specific military encounters. Survive and come out on top in an engagement involving one — explosives or a well-aimed RPG from cover handle them fastest.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store, case the layout and clerk/camera positions first, then execute the robbery while staying out of sightlines the whole time. No alarm trip or witness means a clean, undetected run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Needs 5 separate bank vault robberies completed and escaped clean, not just breached. Keep a fast getaway vehicle staged outside each bank and pre-plan your escape route before triggering the alarm.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks patrol fixed routes around the city. Disable or force one to stop, crack it open, grab the cash and get clear of the responding wanted level to lock in the escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The map is divided into roughly 52 named areas that need to be physically visited to reveal on the map. Fly or drive a grid pattern across the whole state, checking the map's fog-of-war as you go until nothing is left greyed out.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 distinct gangs running illegal operations around Leonida. Identify one operation per gang on the map and rob each — expect retaliation afterward, so keep a getaway plan ready each time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to one of the beachfront bars along Ocean Beach and order a drink from the menu while looking out at the water. It's a quick, low-key trophy best grabbed early while you're already exploring Vice City's coastline.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Walk into any vehicle showroom, hop into a car on the floor, and drive straight through the storefront glass instead of out the front doors — a nod to the series' classic showroom heist intros.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play through a full game on the lanes. Any completed game satisfies this — no score requirement, just follow through on your roll.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A deliberately vague, hidden-until-earned trophy tied to a specific co-op story beat with your partner. Keep progressing the shared missions between the two leads — it surfaces organically at a particular narrative high point rather than from a side activity.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks this as a running counter toward 500 of the game's in-mission dialogue and action choices, both minor and major. Simply keep making choices as they come up across the whole campaign; it ticks up passively and pops once the threshold is hit.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for succeeding on a retry after an in-fiction failure or setback — the game flags a specific moment where failing once and then succeeding on the next attempt is what's being tracked. Just keep playing naturally through story missions that allow a retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for stumbling on one of Leonida's unexplained, X-Files-style random encounters out in the world. Drive the back roads and swampland at night and investigate anything that looks out of the ordinary — it's an easter-egg sighting, not a mission.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While riding as a passenger or on a bike/motorcycle, swing a melee attack out the side to knock down a pedestrian in a single hit, bowling-pin style. A crowded sidewalk at low speed makes the swing easy to land.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty cash that needs laundering through specific contacts rather than banked directly. Keep feeding marked cash through the laundering businesses/contacts until the cumulative cleaned total passes $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: This tracks cumulative spend across clothing stores, barbers, tattoo parlors, weapon shops and other retail — it adds up over the whole playthrough. Favor cosmetic and weapon upgrades you'll actually use so the spend doubles as progress elsewhere.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garage properties scattered across the state. Save up and buy every single one through the real-estate/phone app — garages are a worthwhile buy anyway since they safely store your vehicle collection.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles for rental/sharing. Pull up the app on 10 different vehicles you own or find and register each one — do it in batches during the vehicle-discovery grind to save time.
